title: Animal feeds and feeding stuffs - Methods of sampling for aflatoxin analysis
clause_1_scope: This Standard prescribes the methods of sampling for animal feeds and feeding stufls in relation to the requirements of undesirable characteristics likely to be distributed non-uniformly throughout the feeding stuffs, such as aflatoxins.
clause_3_terminology: Methods of sampling for aflatoxin analysis

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
